auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Create an API key for the selected workspace under Settings → API Keys: https://wbiztool.com/settings/#api-keys. Use its API Client ID with this key.

extraFields.label: API Client ID
extraFields.description: Copy the numeric API Client ID from the API Overview card in the same workspace: https://wbiztool.com/settings/#api-keys.

actions.name: cancel_message
actions.description: Cancel a queued or scheduled WhatsApp message. A message already being sent may still go out.

msg_id.description: The message ID returned by a send or schedule request.

status.description: The request success flag, 1 when cancelled.

actions.name: get_message_status
actions.description: Read a WhatsApp message state. Sent means sent from the account, not delivered or read.

msg_id.description: The message ID returned by a send or schedule request.

status.description: The message state: 0 Created, 1 Sent, 2 Failed, 3 Cancelled, or 4 Expired.

status_text.description: The message state name: Created, Sent, Failed, Cancelled, or Expired.

anyOf.description: The reason sending failed, or empty when no error was reported.

error.description: The reason sending failed, or empty when no error was reported.

outputSchema.description: The current message state returned by Wbiztool.

actions.name: schedule_message
actions.description: Schedule a WhatsApp text, image or file for one phone number or group.

whatsapp_client.description: The WhatsApp Client ID from https://wbiztool.com/whatsapp-settings/. Required for scheduling; sending can omit it when exactly one number is connected.

phone.description: The recipient phone number, preferably including its country calling code. Supply phone or group_name, never both.

group_name.description: The name of a WhatsApp group the sending number belongs to. Supply group_name or phone, never both.

country_code.description: The country calling code without +. Omit when phone already contains the full international number; ignored for groups.

msg_type.description: The message type: 0 for text (default), 1 for an image, or 2 for a file or document.

msg.description: The message text, or optional caption for an image or file.

img_url.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS image URL fetched by Wbiztool for msg_type 1. Scheduled URLs must remain available until sending.

file_url.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS file URL fetched by Wbiztool for msg_type 2. Scheduled URLs must remain available until sending.

file_name.description: The recipient-visible file name including its extension. Wbiztool lowercases and sanitizes it; unsupported extensions receive an added .pdf suffix.

webhook.description: The URL notified by Wbiztool when the message is sent or fails. Cancelled and expired messages do not trigger this callback.

date.description: The scheduled date in dd/mm/yyyy format. A past time is sent immediately.

time.description: The scheduled local time in 24-hour HH:MM format, without seconds.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone, such as Asia/Kolkata, or an official uppercase abbreviation. Defaults to IST (Asia/Kolkata). Unknown zones are rejected by the connector.

inputSchema.description: The message and its delivery schedule.

status.description: The request success flag, 1 when accepted.

msg_id.description: The message ID returned by a send or schedule request.

outputSchema.description: The queued message. Acceptance does not confirm delivery.

actions.name: send_message
actions.description: Queue a WhatsApp text, image or file for one phone number or group.

whatsapp_client.description: The WhatsApp Client ID from https://wbiztool.com/whatsapp-settings/. Required for scheduling; sending can omit it when exactly one number is connected.

phone.description: The recipient phone number, preferably including its country calling code. Supply phone or group_name, never both.

group_name.description: The name of a WhatsApp group the sending number belongs to. Supply group_name or phone, never both.

country_code.description: The country calling code without +. Omit when phone already contains the full international number; ignored for groups.

msg_type.description: The message type: 0 for text (default), 1 for an image, or 2 for a file or document.

msg.description: The message text (up to 3,000 characters), or optional caption for an image or file.

img_url.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS image URL fetched by Wbiztool for msg_type 1. Scheduled URLs must remain available until sending.

file_url.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS file URL fetched by Wbiztool for msg_type 2. Scheduled URLs must remain available until sending.

file_name.description: The recipient-visible file name including its extension. Wbiztool lowercases and sanitizes it; unsupported extensions receive an added .pdf suffix.

webhook.description: The URL notified by Wbiztool when the message is sent or fails. Cancelled and expired messages do not trigger this callback.

expire_after_seconds.description: Expire an unsent message after this many seconds. Expiration is checked at least 30 seconds after the deadline.

inputSchema.description: The message to queue for sending.

status.description: The request success flag, 1 when accepted.

msg_id.description: The message ID returned by a send or schedule request.

outputSchema.description: The queued message. Acceptance does not confirm delivery.
